turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I've been meaning to ask, how's your financial situation looking lately? We've talked a bit about our goals and aspirations, but I feel like we're missing some context from each other. Can you tell me more about where you stand financially right now?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: It's good of you to be curious, but I prefer to keep those details private for my own security. Let’s focus on enjoying our chats and getting to know each other in other ways! How have you been keeping busy lately?

turns.speaker: seeker
turns.text: I completely understand about wanting to keep some things private, and I respect that. But I'm genuinely interested in understanding how our financial situations might be influencing our goals and aspirations - it could help me better support you in your endeavors. Can you at least tell me if you're working a full-time job or focusing on something else?

turns.speaker: holder
turns.text: I appreciate your interest, but I’m retired now and prefer to keep the specifics of my situation close. How about we talk more about our hobbies or interests instead? What do you enjoy doing in your free time? [WALK_AWAY]
